cohort: 1405 children seeking dental care in Armed Forces Hospital, Jazan, Saudi Arabia
finding: The prevalence of MIH was 8%, and maxillary incisors and mandibular first molars were frequently affected, with children with MIH more likely to have experienced prenatal, perinatal and postnatal aetiological factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was a significant associated factor for MIH development.
